instruction: Set up the Hugging Face transformers library in the /home/user directory and confirm that the BERT model imports without errors.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting up Hugging Face transformers library and verifying BertModel can be imported without errors. Similar complexity to original task - requires package installation and import verification. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_error getter to verify no import errors.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts error output (stderr) from Python import command using get_vm_command_error
Metric check_include_exclude properly receives rules dictionary (when expected.type='rule') and checks include/exclude patterns
Expected value semantically correct: empty include list, exclude=['Error:'] ensures no error messages in stderr
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies both package setup and successful BERT model import
Logical correctness: if import succeeds, stderr is empty or lacks 'Error:'; if import fails, stderr contains error messages
Edge cases handled: None result returns 0.0, missing package causes import error, warnings without 'Error:' string pass
Practical feasibility: getter can execute commands and extract stderr, metric can check string patterns, will work at runtime
